Welcome to Wood End Infant & Pre-School
Vision and Aims

Head’s Welcome
Welcome to Wood End Infant & Pre-School! I am very proud of our school and have seen it go from strength to strength in the time that I have been here.
Wood End is a small and nurturing school; as our motto says: ‘Nurturing acorns into sturdy oaks.’ We endeavour to nurture your children ready for the next stage in their education.
Our school is special in many ways. Our Foundation Stage class ensures that children reach a Good Level of Development, which has been consistently above the National Average for the past 4 years. Through child-initiated activities and planning in the moment, we capture the interests of the children and meet individual needs.
Reading and phonics is taught through Read Write Inc. Our highly skilled practitioners ensure children grasp the concept of reading and develop a love of reading from an early age. Our phonics screening check results at the end of Year 1 have been above the National Average for the past four years – in 2017 we were in the top 6% of schools nationally. Each year we are awarded the Ruth Miskin Training Accreditation badge to acknowledge our strength in teaching children to read, write and spell with passion and fidelity.
Claire Wilson
You can request paper copies of any of the information from our website and it will be made available free of charge. Simply contact the school office.

Wraparound Care
Wraparound Care at Wood End
We are happy to be able to offer full wraparound care from 8am to 6pm for children aged over 3.
Wide Awake Club
Early morning wrap-around care, ages 3+
Weekdays during term time, 8.00-8.45am
Breakfast food and fun activities
Woody’s Club
After school wrap-around care, ages 3+
Tues-Wed-Thu-Fri during term time. Mondays currently covered by our Brazilian Soccer club below
Tuesday – Kids with Bricks – Fun with Lego!
Wednesday – Cooking club
Thursday – Dance Club
Friday – Friday Fun! (Activities will vary week to week)
Snack and fun activities each session
Activity Clubs
Mondays: Brazilian Soccer. Led by tutor from Brazilian Soccer School.
We usually offer these activities to Years 1+2 initially in the Autumn Term, then after the Christmas break we open them up to Foundation children too. Both clubs are limited to 16 places.
Booking
PRE-BOOKING ESSENTIAL. We need to know how many children are attending wraparound care at least 24 hours in advance (48 hours for cooking on Wednesday), so that we can arrange correct staffing. (We would need more adults per child for 2-year-olds, this is why we cannot offer the club to children under 3.)
You can book and pay using Parentmail.
Please note, if it is under 24 hours before the session, Parentmail will not allow you to book. We may be able to accommodate in an emergency, please speak to the Office.
PLEASE PAY PROMPTLY. The clubs need to operate on a ‘pay as you go’ basis, so please pay at the time of booking. If we allow debts to build up, then we will be running at a loss and we may not be able to keep the clubs open. If you owe more than £20 then your child will not be permitted to attend until you have paid.
Tap ‘Accounts’
Select the club you want
Tap the dates you want
Make payment
Fees
Please see Parentmail for club times and prices.
If you have difficulty accessing Parentmail, we can accept other methods of payment, please enquire at the office.
For Activity Clubs only (not Wide Awake or Woody’s): If your child is eligible for Pupil Premium, your payment can be subsidised by half. If you are not PP but will struggle to find funds, please contact us in confidence.

pageCache.text:
We use Oxford Reading Buddy here at school. It is a digital reading service that makes reading interactive, motivating and engaging for children aged 4-11.
Pupils can pick from a range of unique interactive characters to encourage curiosity and coach deeper comprehension.
With hundreds of eBooks and comprehension quizzes to suit all Oxford Reading Levels, our teachers here at Wood End can also monitor and support each child’s personal reading and comprehension progress.

Curriculum Overview
Curriculum
The school provides experiences that encourage each child’s intellectual, social, physical, moral, emotional and religious development. The environment is stimulating and interesting, children are encouraged to be as independent as possible, and a variety of teaching and learning strategies are used.
The school sees practical first-hand experience as being very important to young children’s learning and also believes that play is an excellent way of achieving a greater understanding of many ideas. We pay attention to the more able children and plan work to stretch and interest those children. We also identify where children need more support and adapt our teaching to meet every child’s needs.
We are a Forest School and each week the children spend time in the outside learning environment. They take part in exciting activities that help them learn about the world around them and help develop their speaking and listening and social skills.
Below are our curriculum overviews.

pageCache.text:
Forest Tots
One Free Taster Session for First-Timers!
We offer one free taster session for first-time Forest Tots! Come and see how much fun we have together. Simply contact us to arrange your first visit – 01908 316424 or office@woodendsch.org.uk
Forest Tots
UNFORTUNATELY, WE HAVE HAD TO MAKE THE DIFFICULT DECISION TO CANCEL FOREST TOTS FOR THE REST OF THIS TERM. We hope to start again in the new year.
Runs on a Thursday during term time, 9.30 – 11.00am. Please keep an eye on our Facebook page for any changes to sessions.
Ages from 1 year up to school age.
Join our Forest School Leader for a ‘nature play’ session in Wood End’s private Forest School area.
Here at Wood End, we follow the Forest School ethos, which supports play, exploration and supported risk-taking. It develops confidence and self-esteem through learner-inspired, hands-on experiences in a natural setting.
We have a private nature-filled woodland area where the children are free to follow and build on their own interests. We have trees for climbing, a mud kitchen, a tool area, rope swings, a sand pit, a hammock, bird boxes, a pond teeming with wildlife and a fire pit.
Our sessions will incorporate various activities, such as: leaf-printing, bug hunts, den-building, wood craft, painting, pond-dipping – and free play in muddy puddles is always available!
Open to all, not just children currently attending Wood End Pre-School.
All sessions are run by our qualified Forest School Leader and Deputy Forest School Leader.
All Forest Tots children must be accompanied by an adult, the parents/carers will responsible for their own children at all times. Maximum of three children per adult.
Come dressed for all weather – we will run sessions throughout the year, offering children the chance to explore the outdoors in all seasons! Welly boots are essential and sun cream in the summer. We go out in all weathers except for high winds and lightning storms. Our Forest School leader regularly brings her dogs to Forest School. They are supervised at all times. If you have any concerns regarding this please speak to the Forest School Leader.
Find out more about Forest School at Wood End here.
Every Thursday, 9.30 – 11.00am. Ages 1 year – school age.
NO NEED TO BOOK AHEAD. It is useful for us to know that you are coming, so we can contact you if we unexpectedly have to cancel, but not essential. Just fill in the form below if you want us to keep your contact details on file.
Most parents/carers pay cash on the day, please bring the right amount.
It is also possible to pay for sessions by bank transfer, please enquire if interested.
Woodland activities and crafts for children
Refreshments for grown-ups
ParentMail Mailing List
(optional!) You can use the form below to register your details with us. We would use ParentMail to contact you if there were any messages for Forest Tots regulars – for example, if we had to cancel due to bad weather. You can download a paper form here. We will not retain your data for more than 2 years.
We look forward to welcoming you to Forest Tots!

ParentMail
ParentMail
Communicating with parents is an important part of what we do. Making sure you get correct information about activities, events and things that really matter is something we care about.
At Wood End, we use ParentMail to communicate to parents. It’s a service used by over 6,000 schools, nurseries and children’s clubs. ParentMail will benefit you because you can:
Registering with ParentMail is very easy! When your child starts at Wood End, we will send you an email and/or text message via ParentMail. When you receive this, please just follow the instructions in the message. Once registered, if you have an Android or Apple smartphone, we highly recommend you download the ParentMail App for the best user experience. To do this, simply search for “ParentMail” in your App store.
Please be assured that ParentMail is registered with the Information Commissioner and guarantees that all information you provide will be kept private and will not be passed on to any other organisation.
If you need any additional information or assistance, please visit the help site: https://www.parentmail.co.uk/help/parenthelp/ or contact the school office.

Pre-School
Welcome to Wood End Pre-School
Wood End Pre-School is a pre-school for 2, 3 and 4 year olds, which opened in January 2019. Run by Wood End Infant and Pre-School, the Pre-School Leader works in partnership with the school’s Foundation Stage Leader to provide an exciting, stimulating indoor and outdoor environment for children to thrive and develop.
Our staff are caring, friendly and highly experienced in working with Early Years children in a range of settings. Our Pre-School is managed with the same policies and procedures as Wood End Infant School, including Safeguarding, First Aid, SEND and Behaviour Management. We are able to offer the same excellent practice as recognised by OFSTED across the age range from 2 years to 7 years.
The curriculum has been developed using the Early Years Framework to ensure that children have a diverse range of fun, enriching experiences and are nurtured and cared for in a family environment.
Wood End Pre-School is a Governor-led community provision.
Sessions
We offer the following sessions:
Whole days may be taken subject to availability.
Morning – 8.45am – 11.45am
Afternoon – 12.00pm – 3.00pm
Fees/Funding
These are the details of the current fees and charges at our Pre-School.
2-3 year olds – £14.00 per session3-4 year olds – £13.00 per sessionLunch Club – £3.50 per session
Please see the session booking form for charges. Lunch Club is also available for Pre-School morning children – see the Extra Activities page for charges.
Please refer to the Parent Contract for details on when payment of fees are due. If you anticipate any problems, please speak to the Headteacher or Deputy Headteacher and we will certainly do our best to help. All matters will be treated in the strictest confidence.
All 3 and 4 year old children are entitled to Government funding from the start of the term following their 3rd birthday. Full funding is for 15 hours per week, for 38 weeks per year. This can be taken as five 3 hour sessions, vacancies permitting. For rising 4s, two sessions can be taken on the same day at the discretion of the Headteacher and if spaces permit. This is a link to the MK Council website for information on how to apply:
https://www.milton-keynes.gov.uk/children-young-people-families/30-free-childcare-information
Some 3- or 4-year-old children will be eligible for 30 hours free early education.
Time for Twos – If you are eligible for this Government funding then you will be entitled to 15 hours funding per week. This can be taken as five 3 hour morning sessions, vacancies permitting. Here is the link to the council website to apply for Time for Twos funding:-
https://www.milton-keynes.gov.uk/children-young-people-families/time-for-two
To register please either call in to the school office to collect a pack or download the forms from the website. If you would like further information or to book a tour please call the school office on 01908 316424.

Pupil Premium
Pupil Premium Information
Pupil Premium is additional school funding to improve education outcomes for disadvantaged pupils in schools in England. It is paid directly to the school to improve the quality of the children’s education.
This is a link to the Department for Education’s web page which has more general information.
Below are documents that detail Wood End’s use of Pupil Premium funding to help improve the attainment of our disadvantaged pupils.
We ask all parents to fill in this form, as it is standard procedure for us to check eligibility for every child. Even if you think you are probably not eligible, we will check just in case, so please make sure we have these details from you when your child starts here.
